messages:
nina.docs: Quick heads-up: we're renaming the `max_tokens` parameter to `max_output_tokens` across our API and first-party SDKs to reduce ambiguity with model internal token limits. Internal migration doc: https://redwood.inference/internal/docs/max-tokens-rename :memo:

leo.sdk: Timeline? will old param keep working for a while?

nina.docs: Plan: announce now; SDKs will accept `max_tokens` with a warning for two minor releases. Deprecation warning in SDKs/Console begins 2026-05-10, hard error on 2026-07-01. Public docs update 2026-05-12.

carmen.eng: For Dedicated/Private runtimes we can enable a toggle `ALLOW_LEGACY_MAX_TOKENS=true` to preserve behavior for customers that need more time. We'll support exceptions until 2026-08-01 on request.

ash.product: Need short customer copy for Support/Growth. Suggest: "We're renaming `max_tokens` to `max_output_tokens` to make intent explicit — no change in behavior. Update your SDK calls to avoid future breakage."

leo.sdk: Adding small shim in Node/Python: detect `max_tokens`, log a single deprecation warn with link to guide, and copy value into `max_output_tokens`. Shim stays for two minor releases only. Go/Rust will surface warnings via docs and console logs.

nina.docs: Migration snippet for the guide added:

```
# old
resp = client.generate(prompt, max_tokens=512)

# new
resp = client.generate(prompt, max_output_tokens=512)
```

leo.sdk: We'll also add a linter rule in the examples linter to catch `max_tokens` in the examples repo.

notice-bot: created internal doc: /internal/docs/max-tokens-rename  scheduled public KB 2026-05-12 :rocket:

carmen.eng: I'll add an infra metric to track usage of the old key and share a short dashboard next week.

nina.docs: Thanks all  Support/GB please review customer copy and I'll finalize the KB.
